what: the matrix-multiplication tensor as an explicit support, with its mode-1 flattening rank per field

control.claim: the exact rank of <2,2,2> is 7 over every field (Winograd 1971, Kerr 1971)

scope: the mode-1 flattening of <n,n,n> has rank exactly n^2, so it yields only the weak bound r >= n^2. It is a sanity check on the tensor encoding, NOT a step toward the n^2-type bounds the literature needs.
note: for n=3 the flattening rank is 9, matching the flattening rank 9 measured on the repo's rank-23 schemes
